invariants: INV-GOV-SCOPE-STRICT-CONTAINMENT: No command may mutate files outside permitted_write_paths.
INV-GOV-SCOPE-MAX-WRITE-LIMIT: File mutation count must not exceed max_write_files_limit.

provisions.statement: Scope must be checked both before commit on index/worktree and after commit against git diff-tree.
Protected governance files and historical capsules must be rejected if included in write sets without explicit authorization.

scope: Two-phase scope enforcement (pre-commit candidate inspection and post-commit diff-tree firewall).
title: Synthesis Two-Phase Scope Diff Firewall Contract
